_comment: Argo CD app -> Kuma monitors to put under maintenance while Renovate merges a bump for it, and for how many minutes. Read by scripts/renovate-run.sh (via scripts/kuma-silence.py) BEFORE it merges, so a rollout that takes the service down for a few minutes does not page anyone at 06:00 (Frigate 0.18.0 on 2026-09-16: two DOWN pages during a 10 GB image pull). Wider than iac-gate/apps.json on purpose: apps.json lists the fast monitors the gate JUDGES with; this lists everything that would PAGE, including the push monitors of host-side jobs that talk to the service. The gate ignores a monitor under maintenance (beat status 3) and judges on Argo health meanwhile; when the window ends Kuma pages for real if the service is still down, and the gate reverts. Apps absent here are not silenced.
